subject: How to disable click/input for an entire page during reactive processing?

messages.author: c1629c4c1cffcc0e
messages.subject: How to disable click/input for an entire page during reactive processing?
parts:
We have users that can't stop clicking and updating settings while reactive data is processing, causing it to (obviously) re-process multiple times for one process.

Of course one option would be to have an "Update Data" button, but we already tried that and they really do not like that.  (Though we do have that requirement for certain parts of the processing, such as for reactive expressions at the very root level of multiple layers of reactivity, to allow the user to execute the processing without sacrificing tons of time each time they make one simple change.  Anyways ...)

So for these "small" changes to settings, we'd like to set the entire page to "disabled" through JS.  Or at least, some way of preventing the user from creating so many changes/updates to the reactivity process.

Any suggestions?

Thanks!
~Laz Peterson
